title: 2024 Bowman Mega Chrome #BCP-36 Brock Porter Texas Rangers Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a 2024 Bowman Chrome Mega Box containing a Brock Porter Mojo Refractor card. The card is a 1st BCP-36 and is an original from the manufacturer, Topps. The card is made of 35 Pt. card stock and is part of the Bowman Chrome series. It is a sports trading card for baseball fans and is in English language.

The card features the rookie player, Brock Porter, from the Texas Rangers team in the Major League (MLB). It is a standard size card and has no autograph or vintage design. The card attributes are none and it is an original print. The card was manufactured in the United States in 2024 by Topps.
